title: Band-9 Samples: What do you do in summer when the weather’s very hot? [Why?]
passage_text: This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 16 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 2 Test 3 question: “What do you do in summer when the weather’s very hot? [Why?]” Sample 1 Female Male During sweltering summer days, I typically seek refuge in air-conditioned environments, such as shopping malls or cinemas, to escape the oppressive heat. This not only provides respite from the scorching temperatures, but also offers engaging leisure activities. Sample 2 Female Male When the weather’s too hot to handle, I usually retreat to the sanctuary of my air-conditioned home. I spend my time indulging in leisurely activities like reading books or watching movies. Staying indoors not only helps me beat the heat, but also provides a perfect opportunity for relaxation and rejuvenation. Sample 3 Female Male On scorching summer days, I often escape the heat by heading to the library or a local bookstore. Engrossing myself in a good book or browsing through intriguing titles allows me to stay cool while expanding my knowledge and discovering new literary gems. Sample 4 Female Male As a heatwave sets in, I prefer to adopt a siesta culture, taking a midday nap to avoid the most torrid hours. In the early mornings and late evenings, when the weather is more temperate, I engage in outdoor pursuits like jogging or cycling. Sample 5 Female Male When faced with scorching temperatures, I gravitate towards aquatic activities like swimming or visiting a nearby beach. These pursuits not only help me stay cool, but also provide an opportunity to unwind and rejuvenate. Sample 6 Female Male When summer’s heat becomes too much to bear, I relish the chance to take a mini-vacation to a cooler destination. By escaping to the mountains or a lakeside retreat, I can enjoy outdoor activities without being weighed down by sweltering temperatures. It’s a refreshing change of scenery that reinvigorates both body and soul. Sample 7 Female Male As temperatures soar in the summer, I like to engage in indoor sports and fitness activities. By visiting a gym or a sports center with climate control, I can maintain my exercise routine without breaking a sweat in the scorching heat. It’s an excellent way to stay active and healthy, despite the unfavorable weather. Sample 8 Female Male When the summer heat reaches its peak, I enjoy visiting local cafes and ice cream parlors to indulge in frosty treats. Sampling a variety of flavors and sharing these chilly delights with friends and family helps me keep cool and enjoy the sweeter side of life. Sample 9 Female Male When faced with sweltering summer temperatures, I often organize indoor game nights or movie marathons with friends and family. These gatherings, held in the comfort of air-conditioned rooms, offer an enjoyable way to socialize and bond while staying cool and beating the heat. Sample 10 Female Male When the sun’s sizzling hot, I take advantage of online courses and virtual workshops to learn new skills or hone existing ones. In the cool confines of my home, I can focus on self-improvement and personal growth without being encumbered by sweltering temperatures.
